d: Company Description Signalfa is a technology partner and digital agency that helps businesses build strong operational foundations and engaging digital experiences. As an official Odoo partner, the company specializes in implementing and customizing ERP solutions, organizing business data, and developing scalable websites that support long-term growth. Signalfa also delivers performance marketing strategies that enhance brand visibility, customer acquisition, and social media presence. In addition, the team designs gamification concepts and custom game applications that increase user engagement and strengthen connections between brands and their audiences. Signalfa aims to be a long-term growth partner for organizations seeking integrated technology, marketing, and user experience solutions.

Role Description The Business Development Executive – B2B Technology & ERP is a full-time hybrid role based in Masqaţ, Oman, with flexibility for some work from home. This role focuses on identifying and pursuing new B2B opportunities for Odoo ERP, web development, and digital solutions, including performance marketing and gamification services. Day-to-day responsibilities include prospecting and qualifying leads, managing the sales pipeline, conducting product presentations and demos, and preparing proposals tailored to client needs. The position involves building and maintaining relationships with key decision-makers, coordinating with internal technical and marketing teams to shape solutions, and negotiating commercial terms to close deals. The Executive also monitors market trends, contributes to go-to-market strategies, and reports on business development performance to support continuous growth.
q: li
Candidates should possess skills in New Business Development and Lead Generation, including prospecting, pipeline management, and opportunity qualification.
li
Candidates should possess skills in Business and Account Management, including relationship building, client retention, and upselling or cross-selling solutions.
li
Candidates should possess strong Communication skills, including clear written and verbal communication, presentation abilities, and negotiation capabilities.
li

li
Familiarity with digital marketing, web development, or gamification concepts and the ability to translate technical capabilities into business value is preferred.
li
Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets in a business development or sales role.
li
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
li
Comfort working in a hybrid environment and collaborating with cross-functional teams in a dynamic, growth-oriented organization.
